clarity.description: How clearly the defect was described and understood. The rubric score counts how many of four parts the description has: steps to reproduce, expected against actual, environment and acceptance criteria.

complexity.description: How much the defect touched. Source control figures count only defects linked in step 5; a defect with no link is left out, not counted as zero. Lines changed aren't available, because diff text is dropped during anonymisation.

flow.description: Flow describes the system the work moves through (queues, hand-offs and waiting), not the ticket and not the people working on it. Times are in hours and cover defects that reached a done status. Time spent done before a reopen, or in a status missing from the config, is neither active nor waiting.

rework_by_complexity.note: Rework means the defect was reopened or moved backward on the board. Clarity is higher with a rubric score of 3 or more out of 4. Compare clarity within a band, not across bands. These are correlations, not causes.
